newsitem.title: USA: Chase sees commercial loan chargeoffs rising.
newsitem.headline: Chase sees commercial loan chargeoffs rising.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp chief financial officer Peter Tobin said Tuesday that the bank expects to see a modest increase in commercial loan chargeoffs during the rest of the year.
He said Chase had seen a net recovery of $1 million in commerical loans in the second quarter, as opposed to a $58 million chargeoff in the year-earlier period.
Tobin said he did not expect recoveries to continue at that pace and would expect a "modest" increase from this level in the rest of the year.
He also said that an increase in credit card chargeoffs of $100 million in the second quarter was the result of a grwoth in the business, as well as higher delinquincies and bankruptcies.

"But there are very positive trends downward," in those chargeoffs, he said, adding that "we expect the most recent quarter to be the high point and these chargeoffs will be lower in the third quarter."
